cron-viewer.name: Cron Viewer
cron-viewer.description: Explain cron expressions in plain English and preview upcoming run times locally.
cron-viewer.keywords: schedule, scheduled job, cron expression, crontab, quartz, hangfire
cron-viewer.empty: Enter a cron expression to see its schedule.
cron-viewer.unixHint: Unix: minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week.
cron-viewer.quartzHint: Quartz: leading seconds field, ? in day-of-month or day-of-week.
cron-viewer.noRuns: Upcoming runs are unavailable for this expression.
cron-viewer.noRunsQuartz: Upcoming runs are unavailable for this expression in Quartz dialect.

notes.alreadyQuartz: Already 6 or 7 fields; treated as Quartz-style.
notes.bothDays: Quartz can't specify both day-of-month and day-of-week; review manually.
notes.hangfire: Hangfire uses standard Unix cron; unchanged. 6-field (seconds) also supported.

datetime-playground.name: DateTime Playground
datetime-playground.description: Explore dates: add/subtract, ISO week, day-of-year, leap year and diffs, locally.
datetime-playground.keywords: date, time, week number, leap year, date difference, add days, calendar

timestamp.name: Timestamp & Time Zone Converter
timestamp.description: Convert Unix timestamps and dates across UTC, local and world time zones, locally.
timestamp.keywords: timestamp, time zone, date convert, unix, epoch, utc
timestamp.invalid: Could not interpret that as a time.
timestamp.help: Enter a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) or a date string, or press Now.
